meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起一次深度调研,拿到一份带引用、经过质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要就一个陌生领域查大量资料并整理出可信结论。
copy.tagline_en: Run a deep investigation and get back a cited, quality-checked research report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often dig through many sources on a new topic and need a citable result.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按「饱和式研究」流程工作:先自己梳理范围,把研究轴分给一个协作团队,分头查证并交叉质证有争议的结论,最后产出每条论断都带引用或验证证据的研究综述。
howto.when: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、“ulw” 研究等措辞时接管;普通提问、调试或别处收集上下文不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下这个行业的现状
say.note: 会先拆出研究轴,再组建协作团队展开

say.text: 对这个话题做一次深研究,结论都要带出处
say.note: 每条论断会附引用或验证证据

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调查 X,并交叉质证有争议的说法
say.note: 有争议的结论要经过辩论轮次

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a maximum-saturation research flow: it scopes the topic itself, hands research axes to a cooperating team, verifies in parallel and cross-debates contested claims, then delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: It takes over only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use "ulw-research" / "ulw" research wording. Ordinary questions, debugging, or another mode's context-gathering do not activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to study the current state of this industry
say_en.note: It scopes research axes first, then stands up the team

say_en.text: Do a deep research pass on this topic; every claim needs a source
say_en.note: Each claim ships with a citation or verification artifact

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on X and cross-debate the contested claims
say_en.note: Contested claims go through debate rounds
